name: Learn to Skate
summary: Fun drills and games that build skating balance and confidence. Many players start here before Intro to Hockey.

name: Intro to Hockey
summary: Skating, passing, and shooting fundamentals for new players. Pathways into Minor Hockey.

name: Minor Hockey
summary: One practice and one game per week focused on skill development and game sense before moving into age-group leagues.

name: 10U
summary: Structured practices and games 2–3 times per week. Travel opportunities at ECHO, TORHS, and NARCh when teams are entered.

name: 13U
summary: Competitive youth hockey with advanced skill work. Players often continue into adult leagues or ice pathways abroad.

name: 16U
summary: Older youth competitive group. CIIHF is fielding a 2026 16U travel team.

name: Men's Roller Hockey
summary: Tuesday-night league, typically four teams, competing for the King's Cherry Cup.
schedule: Tuesdays at King's Sports Centre (confirm season dates)

name: Sunday Drop-In
summary: Casual drop-in hockey almost year-round on Sundays.
